nodes.name: Charlie Kirk Pre-Death Texts Saying He Expected to Be Killed Verification
nodes.description: Persistent investigable target: whether text messages exist in which Charlie Kirk told TPUSA staff and security guards the day before his death that he thought they would kill him the next day, as the host alleges.

nodes.name: TPUSA Post-Assassination Merchandise Revenue Claim
nodes.description: Persistent investigable target: the host's claim that TPUSA made $80 million plus in merchandise sales in the first three weeks after September 10 and its whole annual budget in the first couple of weeks.

nodes.name: Pentagon Press Corps Credentialing Overhaul
nodes.description: Persistent investigable target: the Pentagon's late-2025 press corps change, who was credentialed (including Laura Loomer and Cam Higby), and the criteria used.

claims.label: TPUSA publicly invited Candace to participate in a Phoenix livestream to address allegations
claims.claim: TPUSA, via Blake Neff's video statement, announced a planned Phoenix livestream and extended a public invitation to the host to participate.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm whether the livestream occurred, who attended, and which questions were answered; obtain recording or transcript.

claims.label: TPUSA asserted Charlie personally reviewed and signed off on every bill paid by the organization
claims.claim: In the video statement, TPUSA asserted that Charlie personally reviewed and signed off on every expense report and every bill paid by the organization down to a single United States dollar.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check against internal expense approval records and witness testimony; investigate Charlie's DOGE-related audit request as a separate counter-signal.

claims.label: TPUSA asserted the organization has never missed a 990 deadline
claims.claim: In the video statement, TPUSA asserted that the organization has never missed a 990 filing deadline.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify filing history against IRS Form 990 public records.

claims.label: TPUSA framed host's questions as "beneath contempt," citing Charlie's "do not feed the trolls" rule
claims.claim: In the video statement, TPUSA cited Charlie's "do not feed the trolls" rule and characterized the host's allegations as beneath contempt as justification for prior non-response.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Charlie's documented communications on troll-handling policy; assess whether the rule was invoked consistently across other allegations.

claims.label: Cam Higby asked Pentagon press secretary about French military plot to assassinate Candace Owens
claims.claim: At a Pentagon briefing, newly-credentialed journalist Cam Higby asked Pentagon press secretary Kingsley Wilson whether the DoD has any evidence of a French military plot to assassinate Candace Owens.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the briefing date and credentialing record; obtain full transcript of the briefing exchange.

claims.label: Kingsley Wilson responded she was not aware of evidence of a French military plot
claims.claim: Pentagon press secretary Kingsley Wilson responded "not that I'm aware of" to the question of whether DoD had evidence of a French military plot to assassinate Candace Owens, and suggested it might be more of a law enforcement matter.
claims.investigative_direction: Track any follow-up statement from DoD or law enforcement regarding the underlying allegation.

claims.label: The Game's upcoming mixtape contains a track titled "The Assassination of Candace Owens"
claims.claim: The Game is releasing a mixtape that contains a track titled "The Assassination of Candace Owens."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the track listing against the released mixtape; obtain the song lyrics and release date.

claims.label: The Game stated the track is not about Candace personally and uses her name metaphorically
claims.claim: The Game stated in the interview that the song is not about Candace personally and that he used the title because she "self-admitted" feeling targeted, framing it as a metaphor about "assassination of the character."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the artist's stated intent against the released song lyrics.

claims.label: Fortune article headline referenced the Macron lawsuit and Candace's media empire
claims.claim: A Fortune article published December 2 carried the headline "Inside the economics of Candace Owens's media empire and the Macron lawsuit threatening to unravel it."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Fortune article, capture full byline, and verify publication date.

claims.label: Fortune article framed lawsuit as testing whether "controversy as currency" model could survive legal battle
claims.claim: The Fortune article stated that the lawsuit would test whether the "controversy as currency" model that enriched the host and built her media brand could survive what experts described as an immensely costly legal battle.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the quoted phrasing against the original article and identify the named "experts."

claims.label: Macron had a recorded phone call with Trump at 6:45 PM French time on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: Per host reference, Emmanuel Macron's public calendar records a phone call with Donald Trump at 6:45 PM French time (10:45 AM Utah time) on September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Macron's released public calendar; confirm the timestamp and any documented subject of the call.

claims.label: Host Accepts TPUSA's Public Invitation or Challenge
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA moved to formally respond to her and issued a public invitation or challenge, and that she accepts it.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the host's on-air acceptance and any written reply to TPUSA; compare with TPUSA's own account of what was offered.
claims.transcript_snippet: they at long last issued a public invitation or a challenge. I'm not sure what it is, but I accept.

claims.label: Host Credits Tipsters, TPUSA Leakers and Donors
claims.claim: The host says people in her inbox gave her tips, people inside TPUSA were leaking, and donors wrote public letters and sent private messages encouraging her to continue.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the public donor letters; the claim about leakers can be tested only through the host's sources.
claims.transcript_snippet: every single person who was in my inbox giving me tips, the people inside of Turning Point USA who were leaking, the donors that wrote public letters

claims.label: Neff Is Producer of the Charlie Kirk Show, Kolvet Is Spokesperson
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff is the producer and a rotating on-air talent of the Charlie Kirk Show, and that she expected TPUSA spokesperson Andrew Kolvet to deliver the response.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Blake Neff's and Andrew Kolvet's published TPUSA titles and roles on the Charlie Kirk Show.
claims.transcript_snippet: Blake Neff, by the way, is the producer of the Charlie Kirk show.

claims.label: Host Says Neff Has Defended Mikey McCoy's Actions
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff has been defending the actions of Mikey McCoy on September 10, and that she senses he believes he is telling the truth.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect Neff's prior public statements about McCoy's conduct on September 10 and compare them with this statement.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's been the only person that has been responding in a way that feels even remotely authentic when he defends the actions of Mikey McCoy on that day.

claims.label: Neff Says He Has Seen Mikey McCoy's Birth Certificate
claims.claim: In the statement the host plays, Blake Neff says that Candace Owens suggested Michael is not Mikey McCoy's real name and that he has seen McCoy's birth certificate himself.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TPUSA whether the birth certificate can be shown; trace where the name allegation first aired.
claims.transcript_snippet: She has suggested Michael is not his real name. It is I have seen his birth certificate myself.

claims.label: Neff Says McCoy's Wife Does Not Work on Campus Events
claims.claim: In the statement the host plays, Blake Neff says Mikey McCoy's wife works at TPUSA but does not work on campus events, and so did not plan the Utah event.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA's staff role description for McCoy's wife and the event-planning roster for the UVU event.
claims.transcript_snippet: She doesn't work on campus events.

claims.label: Host Says She Did Not Claim McCoy's Wife Planned the Event
claims.claim: The host says she never said Mikey McCoy's wife helped plan the event; she says she called it suspicious that nobody ever found out who planned it, and that the wife works in events.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the original episode where the host raised McCoy's wife and event planning, and find who TPUSA says planned the UVU event.
claims.transcript_snippet: I said it was suspicious that Mikey McCoy's wife um that we never found out who did plan the event.

claims.label: Host Says McCoy Must Answer for Who He Was on the Phone With at the Shot
claims.claim: The host says she believes Mikey McCoy should have to answer for who he had on the phone right when the shot went off.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain McCoy's call log or his account of the call he was on at the moment of the shot.
claims.transcript_snippet: I do believe that Mikey McCoy should have to answer for who he had on the phone right when the shot went off.

claims.label: Host Says Rob McCoy Spoke of Charlie's Notebooks and Mikey Then Took the Liberty Stage
claims.claim: The host says Rob McCoy spoke about Charlie's notebooks and about how Mikey McCoy was talented, and that Mikey then went onto Liberty University's stage for an event that had been scheduled for Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the recording of Rob McCoy's remarks about the notebooks and confirm the Liberty University event date and who spoke.
claims.transcript_snippet: his own father is the one that spoke about Charlie's notebooks and spoke about how Mikey McCoy was talented.

claims.label: Host Alleges Rob McCoy Sanitized a Man Who Went to Prison Over Photographing Young Girls
claims.claim: The host alleges that in words she played, Rob McCoy tried to sanitize a person who spent time in prison for trying to take photos of young girls, and says she does not think Rob McCoy is a good guy.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the person in the played clip, check court records for the conviction, and review the original clip of McCoy's remarks.
claims.transcript_snippet: tried to sanitize someone who spent time in prison for being a sexual deviant, right, for trying to take photos of uh, young girls.

claims.label: Host Says Tours Since 2019 Were Decided the Semester Before
claims.claim: The host says she worked for TPUSA and went on every tour since 2019, and that tour events are typically decided at least the semester before.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare scheduling dates of prior TPUSA campus tour stops against the UVU event announcement date.
claims.transcript_snippet: I worked for Turning Point USA and I went on every uh tour, every tour since 2019. And typically those events are decided at least the semester before.

claims.label: Host Says UVU Event Came Together Quickly and She Has Emails
claims.claim: The host says the Utah Valley University event came together very quickly, that this was unusual, and that she holds emails supporting that claim.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the emails the host says she holds and the UVU event booking records.
claims.transcript_snippet: This came together very quickly. It is unusual and I don't know why you think that you are going to be able to disprove that notion when I have the emails to support that claim.

claims.label: Host Says She Never Said TPUSA Lied About Foreign Aircraft
claims.claim: The host says she never said Turning Point lied about foreign aircraft following Erika Kirk because TPUSA never responded on the subject.
claims.investigative_direction: Review earlier episodes for any host statement that TPUSA lied about aircraft.
claims.transcript_snippet: Definitely never said Turning Point lied because you never responded.

claims.label: Host Says Egyptian Jets First Seemed to Follow Charlie, Then TPUSA Faith Events and Erika
claims.claim: The host says she first plotted Egyptian jets as following Charlie, then realized they were tracking TPUSA Faith events and that many more times they were following, and perhaps tracking, Erika.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-plot the Egyptian-registered aircraft movements against Erika Kirk's public schedule.
claims.transcript_snippet: We then obviously realized that they were tracking TPUSA faith events and that many more times uh they were following and perhaps tracking Erika.

claims.label: Host Says Denial of Charlie Wanting Erika to Take Over Is Not a Quotation
claims.claim: Responding to TPUSA's line that she accused it of lying about Charlie wanting Erika to take over for him if he died, the host says 'Never happened. That is not a quotation. That is just them saying that.'
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the audio the host references and TPUSA's original denial; the speaker attribution of the opening words is ambiguous in the transcript.
claims.transcript_snippet: Never happened. That is not a quotation. That is just them saying that.

claims.label: Host Says Security Gave Charlie No First Aid
claims.claim: The host says Charlie's security did not issue him first aid when he fell, nobody pulled out gauze to stop the bleeding, and that they have admitted this.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the available footage and Harpole's own interview for any first-aid attempt.
claims.transcript_snippet: They did not issue him first aid when he fell down. There was nobody who pulled out um any gauze and tried to stop the bleeding.

claims.label: Host Says Harpole Told Shawn Ryan the Injury Severity Explained No First Aid
claims.claim: The host says that in a sitdown with Shawn Ryan, Brian Harpole said no first aid was given because of the severity of the injury.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Shawn Ryan interview for the exact Harpole statement on first aid.
claims.transcript_snippet: In a sitdown with Shawn Ryan, Brian Harpole said it was because of the severity of the injury.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Said the SD Card Was Taken Because People Were Stealing
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet sat next to the person delivering TPUSA's statement and said the SD card was removed because people were stealing.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the Kolvet statement on SD card removal and compare it with the other accounts of who took the card and why.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Kolvet sat next to you and said it was because people were stealing.

claims.label: Host Says Cameras Rather Than the SD Card Would Be Taken to Stop Theft
claims.claim: The host says that if people were stealing, one would grab the expensive cameras and not the SD card, for an event that was being livestreamed.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish what was livestreamed, what equipment was present, and who removed the card.
claims.transcript_snippet: People were stealing. you probably would want to grab the very expensive cameras and not the SD card for an event that was being livereamed.

claims.label: Host Says She Did Not Allege Bowyer Abused an Intern
claims.claim: The host says she did not say Tyler Bowyer abused an intern or that it was non-consensual; she says she said he likes younger boys, not minors but much younger than him.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the earlier episode where the host first raised the Bowyer allegation.
claims.transcript_snippet: I didn't say that he abused him. I didn't say it was not consensual. I said that he likes younger boys.

claims.label: Host Says She Can Give the Name of an Intern Bowyer Hooked Up With
claims.claim: The host says she can give the exact name of the intern Tyler Bowyer hooked up with and that this person was not at Turning Point USA.
claims.investigative_direction: The host would need to supply the intern's name and corroboration; treat as an unverified allegation.
claims.transcript_snippet: And yeah, I can give you the exact name of the intern that he hooked up with. That person was not at Turning Point USA.

claims.label: Host Says Current TPUSA Workers Say Bowyer Tried to Hook Up With Them
claims.claim: The host alleges that people currently working at TPUSA say Tyler Bowyer, and that these were young men, tried to hook up with them after events.
claims.investigative_direction: Unverified allegation from unnamed sources; seek independent corroboration and a response from Bowyer.
claims.transcript_snippet: people that are currently um working for Turning Point USA who said that Tyler Bowyer and these are young men tried to hook up with them after um uh some events.

claims.label: Neff Statement Says Host Called Turek and McCoy Part of a Military Infiltration
claims.claim: In the statement the host plays, Blake Neff says Candace Owens suggested TPUSA Faith pastors including Frank Turek and Rob McCoy are part of a military infiltration of Turning Point.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against the host's earlier statements about military ties of Turek and McCoy.
claims.transcript_snippet: She has suggested that TPUSA faith affiliated pastors like theologian Frank Turek, who we'll have on in a moment, and pastor Rob McCoy, are part of a military quote infiltration of Turning Point

claims.label: Host Cites Calvary Chapel's Chuck Smith Era as a CIA Infiltration Effort
claims.claim: The host says she believes the evidence shows Calvary Chapel's history under Chuck Smith was a militant CIA effort to infiltrate the Christian faith, in a founding during the 1960s.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the documents or historical sources for a CIA role in Calvary Chapel's founding.
claims.transcript_snippet: I do believe the Calvary Chapel uh their history with Chuck Smith, the evidence that it was a militant CIA effort to infiltrate the Christian faith

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Holds Texts in Which Charlie Said They Would Kill Him Tomorrow
claims.claim: The host alleges that people at TPUSA possess text messages from the day before Charlie's death in which he wrote to TPUSA staff and security guards that he thought they were going to kill him tomorrow.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the text messages or the host's source; ask TPUSA to confirm or deny that such messages exist.
claims.transcript_snippet: people at Turning Point USA are in possession of text messages and the day before Charlie died in which he wrote out to you and not just to people that work at Turning Point USA

claims.label: Host Says Her 'Betrayed by Everyone' Line Came From a Dream
claims.claim: The host says her statement that Charlie was betrayed by everyone was a dream she had, and also a realization.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the original episode in which the host said Charlie was betrayed by everyone.
claims.transcript_snippet: Sorry, that was a dream that I had. And it is also a a realization

claims.label: Host Says Josh Hammer Lied That Charlie Never Blinked on Israel
claims.claim: The host says Josh Hammer falsely said that Charlie never blinked on Israel and that TPUSA stayed silent when he did.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Josh Hammer statement and compare with Charlie's documented position on Israel.
claims.transcript_snippet: your silence during moments when people are lying, like Josh Hammer when he said, "Hey, this never happened. Charlie never blinked on Israel."

claims.label: Host Says Neff's Quote Is Partial and Reframes Her Words
claims.claim: The host says Neff's quote is not a full quotation and that she never said, in the context he put it, that Charlie's friends 'had to know' he was going to be murdered, and that she may have said the sentence but the full sentence is needed.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the full original sentence and compare with TPUSA's paraphrase.
claims.transcript_snippet: I never said that obviously in the context that he put it in uh that Charlie's friends quote had to know he was going to be murdered.

claims.label: Neff Says Charlie Had TPUSA Audited by a Third Party Every Year
claims.claim: In the statement the host plays, Blake Neff says Charlie made sure TPUSA was audited by a third party every year.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA's annual audited financial statements and auditor name.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie made sure the organization was audited by a third party every year.

claims.label: Host Says Most People Cannot Read the Forms Showing What Happened to the $80 Million
claims.claim: The host says that if a charity is moving millions into various LLCs 'that have your name on it' that is improper, and that most people cannot read those forms or understand what happened to 'the $80 million'.
claims.investigative_direction: Review TPUSA and Turning Point Action Form 990 and LLC filings for the $80 million figure the host references.
claims.transcript_snippet: most people are not able to read those forms and won't understand what's happening to the the $80 million.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Requested a DOGE Department 7 Days Before He Died
claims.claim: The host says Charlie explicitly requested putting together a DOGE department seven days before he died, and that this is not the same as an annual audit.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the internal TPUSA memo or message that established the DOGE department and its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: I am struck by the fact that you're still trying to conflate an annual audit with Charlie's explicit request to put together a Doge department 7 days before he died.

claims.label: Host Says Inside Sources Say Charlie Wanted DOGE Because He Did Not Know Where the Money Went
claims.claim: The host says inside sources at TPUSA say Charlie wanted DOGE because he did not know where the money was coming from or where it was going.
claims.investigative_direction: Test through the host's sources and the DOGE memo; seek TPUSA's explanation of the department's purpose.
claims.transcript_snippet: inside sources at your own company say it was because he didn't know where the money was coming from or how quickly and where exactly the money was being evaporated to.

claims.label: Neff Says Host Alleged French Paratroopers, Egyptian Planes, Tunnels and Soccer-Team Hoodies
claims.claim: In the statement the host plays, Blake Neff lists allegations he says the host made, including French paratroopers in maroon shirts, Egyptian Air Force planes flying out of Provo, underground tunnels and suspicion of UVU soccer players in hoodies.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare each listed item with the host's original statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: Candace has made other stranger allegations involving French paratroopers in maroon shirts.

claims.label: Host Says It Broke That Day That the Saudi King Was on the Plane in 2023
claims.claim: The host says it broke on the day of this episode that the Saudi king had at some point in 2023 been aboard the Egyptian plane.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the report about the Saudi king and the aircraft and check the tail number and date.
claims.transcript_snippet: today it broke that like the Saudi king was this plane at some point, 2023.

claims.label: Host Says She Never Covered the Green Hoodie People
claims.claim: The host says she never went after anyone for wearing a green hoodie and never covered the green hoodie people, and that she only shared a picture when asked.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the host's shows and posts for any discussion of the green hoodie person.
claims.transcript_snippet: Saying that I went after somebody for wearing a green hoodie is not true at all. We never even covered the green hoodie people on this show.

claims.label: Host Says the Green-Hoodie Person Was Not Upset and Responded
claims.claim: The host says the person wearing the green hoodie was not upset about the picture and responded.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the green-hoodie person's response and the post that carried it.
claims.transcript_snippet: And the person wearing the green hoodie was not even upset about it. He responded.

claims.label: Host Guarantees Maroon-Shirt People Represent a Military Unit
claims.claim: The host says she stands by her statements about people in maroon shirts and guarantees they represent a military unit somewhere.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the maroon-shirt individuals and any unit affiliation from public records.
